filter 8d.description: Applies an 8D audio effect to the music.

filter bassboost.description: Enhances bass frequencies in the music.

filter karaoke.description: Applies a karaoke filter to the music.

filter nightcore.description: Applies a nightcore effect to the music.

filter pop.description: Applies a pop equalizer preset to the music.

filter soft.description: Applies a soft, muffled filter to the music.

filter treblebass.description: Enhances treble and bass frequencies in the music.

filter tremolo.description: Applies a tremolo effect to the music.

filter vaporwave.description: Applies a vaporwave effect to the music.

filter vibrato.description: Applies a vibrato effect to the music.

library like.description: Likes or unlikes the currently playing song.

library lyrics.description: Looks up lyrics for a song.

query.description: The song to search for. Defaults to the currently playing song.

music 247.description: Toggles 24/7 mode — the bot stays connected instead of leaving an empty queue.

music add.description: Adds a song to the queue.

query.description: The search query or URL for a song or playlist.

music autoplay.description: Toggles autoplay — keeps queueing related tracks once the queue empties.

music clear.description: Clears every upcoming song from the queue.

music dj clear.description: Clears the DJ role, allowing everyone to control music.

music dj set.description: Sets the DJ role for music commands.

role.description: The role that can control music playback.

music forward.description: Forwards the current track by 10 seconds.

music grab.description: Sends the currently playing song to your DMs.

music join.description: Makes the bot join your voice channel.

music leave.description: Makes the bot leave the voice channel.

music loop.description: Cycles the loop mode between off, track and queue.

music move.description: Moves the player to a different voice channel.

voice.description: The voice channel to move to.

text.description: The text channel to send player messages to.

music queue.description: Lists the songs in the queue.

music remove.description: Removes a song from the queue.

position.description: The position of the song to remove.

music replay.description: Replays the current track from the beginning.

music rewind.description: Rewinds the current track by 10 seconds.

music seek.description: Seeks to a position (in seconds) in the current track.

seconds.description: The position to seek to, in seconds.

music stop.description: Stops playback and clears the queue.
